headline: Apple tightens Mac disk-access rules for AI agents amid Muse dispute
summary: Meta's Muse AI agent was accused of reading a user's private messages without permission, a claim Meta disputes. Separately, Apple announced it is tightening macOS Full Disk Access controls, warning that AI agents' broad access to files, messages, mail and browsing history is increasingly risky. Coverage frames Apple's move as a response to Meta's view that existing controls were not sufficient.
